% Independent Tectonic observations for macro invocation and expanded definitions.
\documentclass{article}
\def\part{xspace}
\edef\load{\noexpand\RequirePackage{\part}}
\load
\makeatletter
\@ifpackageloaded{xspace}{\typeout{PYTEXML package=loaded}}{\typeout{PYTEXML package=missing}}
\makeatother
\typeout{PYTEXML load=\meaning\load}
\def\pair#1#2{#2#1}
\def\start{\pair{A}}
\edef\joined{\start{B}TAIL}
\typeout{PYTEXML joined=\meaning\joined}
\def\original{OLD}
\let\saved\original
\def\original{NEW}
\edef\aliases{\saved/\original}
\typeout{PYTEXML aliases=\meaning\aliases}
\def\hash{##}
\def\numbertoken{1}
\edef\copy#1{\hash\numbertoken}
\typeout{PYTEXML copy=\meaning\copy}
\edef\result{\copy{VALUE}}
\typeout{PYTEXML result=\meaning\result}
\def\old{A}
\edef\held{\noexpand\old}
\def\old{B}
\edef\later{\held}
\typeout{PYTEXML held=\meaning\held}
\typeout{PYTEXML later=\meaning\later}
\edef\inert{\catcode64=11}
\typeout{PYTEXML atcode=\the\catcode64}
\begin{document}
Expansion witness.
\end{document}
